::: remark

[Proof by induction](proof-writing.qmd#def-proof-by-induction) proves a statement about every integer from some starting integer on.
Sequences defined by a rule on their earlier terms are the usual place to use it.
This page defines the sequences,
then adds the stronger form of induction that they often need.

:::
